issues.title: feat: a contract gate that opts into one retry
issues.body:
The unit gate this issue defines is red the first time and green the second.

## 対象ファイル
- `docs/adr.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] the retry is carried by the contract

```acceptance-gates
version: 1
gates:
  - id: issue-330-flaky-probe
    command: "sh -c 'if [ -f .flake-seen ]; then exit 0; fi; : > .flake-seen; exit 1'"
    timeoutSec: 120
    retryOnFail: 1
    flakyIsPass: true
```
